definitions.value_index: a valued campaign's contestants divided by the median contestants of every valued campaign in the same stated-USD value band, so it already controls for value band
definitions.value_band: the eleven stated-USD prize pool bands used throughout the prize skills
definitions.size_band: contestant count band (100-250, 250-500, 500-1k, 1k-2.5k, 2.5k-10k, 10k+), the standard organizer-scale proxy used across analysis scripts
definitions.email/referral/follow_per_contestant: completions of email-subscribe, share-action and any follow or subscribe-type action, summed per campaign and divided by contestants
definitions.own_product: word overlap between organizer name and prize name (analyze.own_product_signal, carried from the classification file), true for any prize on the campaign
definitions.generic_prize: prize category is gift card or cash, bundle or box, subscription or membership, or a discount, all of which suit any audience
definitions.audience_specific_prize: prize category matches the weak industry-to-category fit map (a gaming item on a gaming site, tech hardware on an electronics site, and so on)
definitions.niche_mismatch: a definite (non-generic, non-placeholder) prize category that does not match the organizer's industry in the fit map
definitions.bundle: campaign lists two or more prize rows, or its top-counted category is bundle_or_box
definitions.collab: the campaign or prize name matches an x/collaboration/partner wording pattern, same regex as verify_context.py
definitions.scope: ordinary segment, 1,000+ contestants, valid_entries > 0; every published group needs 30 campaigns and 5 organizers, 10 organizers for a cut finer than one industry or tier group
definitions.elasticity_vs_prior_band: percent change in median contestants divided by percent change in the band midpoint value versus the previous band; near zero or negative means more prize money bought no more entrants between those two bands
